title: UFO history hidden in Tom DeLonge's fiction series

tellings.quote: And I think a lot of UFO history is hidden in plain sight visav these fiction books. So you have uh Tom Dong uh Blink 182 frontman writing with Peter Levvena and AJ Hartley this this whole series

plain: Real UFO history is said to be hidden in plain sight inside a series of novels written by Tom DeLonge, the frontman of the rock band Blink-182, together with the writers Peter Levenda and AJ Hartley. Michels gives this as his own view on a 2025 episode with Jake Barber, a guest who says he helped recover a UFO by helicopter. He does not name the books or point to which parts he believes are true.
